evaluation_notes: The relative inverse-depth model needs per-image scale and shift alignment against inverse metric GT; this is an oracle-aligned shape evaluation, not an absolute metric-depth prediction result.
Use a common GT-only valid mask for all model variants and separately report inpainted versus measured depth.
This is a fixed 128-image subset by default and no crop, so its scores are not directly comparable to full-654 cropped benchmark results.

method.interpretation: Oracle relative-depth evaluation: each prediction uses the evaluated image's GT to fit inverse-depth scale and shift; this is not absolute metric-distance accuracy
method.alignment: Float64 least squares fit s*prediction+t to 1/GT_depth on all GT-valid pixels, s>=0; s=0 boundary is flagged when unconstrained fit is nonpositive or prediction is constant
method.prediction_restoration: Original GT resolution, bilinear align_corners=True before alignment; no crop
method.preprocessing: Fixed square518x518 OpenCV CUBIC without crop (aspect ratio can change), official RGB/ImageNet normalization
method.common_mask: Only supplied GT mask AND finite GT AND min_depth<GT<max_depth; identical across models; no prediction-dependent pixel exclusion
method.inverse_depth_clamp: Only for inversion into positive depth: max(aligned_inverse,1/max_depth), then reciprocal; pixels remain scored and clipped fraction is recorded; no near-distance prediction cap
method.inverse_error: inverse_nrmse uses the unclipped aligned inverse prediction, RMSE divided by standard deviation of GT inverse depth on the GT-valid mask
method.aggregation: Main metrics are arithmetic mean across per-image metrics; separately labeled pixel-weighted diagnostics are also provided
method.uncertainty: Paired percentile bootstrap of AbsRel and inverse-NRMSE differences, 10000 resamples and seed42: both individual images and whole scene/sequence clusters. Scene resamples sum selected scene delta sums and divide by selected scene image counts, retaining the per-image mean estimand; undefined inverse-NRMSE pairs are counted and omitted only from that metric's CI
method.calibration: Evaluation GT/images are not used to calibrate the quantized weights; GT is used only for the explicitly labeled per-image oracle alignment
method.timing: No latency benchmark is performed by this script
